targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS t, count() AS c FROM analytics.netflow_logs WHERE timestamp >= now() - 3600 GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS t, sum(bytes * 8) / 60 AS bps FROM analytics.netflow_logs WHERE timestamp >= now() - 3600 GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT src_ip, count() AS flows, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, sum(packets) AS total_packets FROM analytics.netflow_logs WHERE timestamp >= now() - 3600 GROUP BY src_ip ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT multiIf(protocol=6,'TCP',protocol=17,'UDP',protocol=1,'ICMP',toString(protocol)) AS proto, count() AS c FROM analytics.netflow_logs WHERE timestamp >= now() - 3600 GROUP BY proto ORDER BY c DESC
SELECT dst_port, count() AS flows, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes FROM analytics.netflow_logs WHERE timestamp >= now() - 3600 GROUP BY dst_port ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT timestamp, src_ip, dst_ip, src_port, dst_port, protocol, bytes, packets FROM analytics.netflow_logs ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50
